messages:
zoe: FYI — MegaBank wants an unusual request: they want a model-pin escrow and committed migration credits if we deprecate model-y-v1 within 12 months. they want the escrow to guarantee a rollback artefact and a backed-up quant config. asking for product input.
anil: Can you clarify "what" they want escrowed? model checkpoints, quant params, and a compatibility wrapper?
zoe: Exactly. their compliance requires an artefact they can store for audits. they also want written guarantees that we won't force a migration without 60d notice + credit remedy.
brian: Hmm. From runtime this means we need to ship an exportable package (model binary + quant config + a minimal serving shim) and a signed hash + retention policy. that's doable but has storage & security implications. lucy any infra concerns?
lucy: Storage: encrypted blobs in S3 with KMS per-tenant. retention SLA: 2 years minimum. adds ~0.2GB per large model per tenant. operationally we need a lifecycle job to purge after the retention window. ops-bot: Note: any per-tenant long-term storage >30 days triggers billing approval.
finance: we'll need to define the escrow fee or include as part of a migration credit cap. otherwise customers expect it free. recommend: escrow setup fee + modest monthly storage fee OR a migration-credit-first model (credits up to $X).
legal: compliance note: escrow artefacts may be considered customer data. need DPA addendum + tamper-evident logging. also define permitted uses of the artefact (audit-only vs. on-prem restore).
anil: For product: two levers we can offer: 1) Pin escrow + migration-credit guarantee (timebound), 2) Non-escrow long pin with strict gating + engineering support. both should include telemetry & gating obligations.
brian: Benchmarks: we should require a locked eval-suite snapshot and snapshot of embedding baselines. propose a monthly signed report that we share with them during the pin window. gating metrics: embed median cosine >= 0.94, intent F1 >= baseline -2%, p95 delta <= 25ms.
zoe: Customer prefers credits, but they're price-sensitive. they want a cap on how many times we can ask them to migrate without credit. specify: if forced early migration within 12 months, credit = 3 months equivalent of their Dedicated commitment or $Y whichever smaller.
finance: we can model that. need an approval matrix for Y. also need to ensure credits don't break revenue recognition.
legal: add: all migration credits must be explicitly consented in contract amendment. recorded opt-in required.
lucy: Runtime mode: we can expose a compatibility mode that uses old KV layout + flag in route config. example:

redwood admin compat enable --tenant megabank --model model-y-v1 --expiry 2025-09-30

That will enable dual-path decoding for pinned tenants. but note perf hit: ~6-12% CPU/GPU overhead.
brian: Also define rollback & canary steps for any future forced migration: 1) 5% canary, 3 days -> 25% 7 days -> full. automatic rollback if p95 delta > threshold or quality drop > threshold.
zoe: We should draft a customer one-pager that includes: what they get, costs, gating, escrow retention, credit formula, and contact points. aim to keep it one page.
anil: Policy: any escrow + credit package that exceeds 9 months pin or $100k credit needs VP approval. let's add that.
finance: action: i'll run a quick cost model for escrow storage + compat overhead and provide numbers in 48h.
legal: action: i'll draft contract language + DPA addendum in 72h.
brian: action: i'll produce the eval gating matrix and a minimal export package spec (signed artefact format) in 72h.
lucy: action: I'll prototype the admin compat command and measure perf delta in 5 days.
zoe: timeline suggestion: internal review (3 business days) -> draft one-pager to customer (5 business days) -> contract sign (TBD).
ops-bot: Reminder: per policy POL-ESCROW-1, storing third-party artefacts requires encryption-at-rest and quarterly audit.
anil: quick question — do we allow multiple escrows per tenant across multiple models? that could explode storage & upkeep. proposal: limit to 3 simultaneous escrowed models per tenant unless exec-approved.
zoe: noted, adding that to the one-pager.
finance: FYI — credits can be structured as consumption credits applied monthly until exhausted; easier from billing flows.
legal: Also require that if the customer uses the escrow artefact to self-host, they must not claim support from Redwood for that self-hosted infra unless they purchase a support add-on. add clause.
zoe: ok thanks team. I'll assemble the one-pager draft and drop it here by EOD tomorrow. everyone, please deliver your action items on the timelines above. :memo:
